newsitem.title: USA: ECC says in talks over possible sale of co.
newsitem.headline: ECC says in talks over possible sale of co.

text.p: ECC International Corp said Wednesday it is in talks with several parties interested in buying all or part of the company.
The company said Oppenheimer & Co Inc is working with the board to identify purchasers for the business in accordance with the terms of a proposal approved by stockholders at the annual meeting.
ECC said Oppenheimer has identified several companies who have expressed preliminary interest in considering the acquisition of all or parts of ECC's businesses.
